_comment: Supabase project refs for the environment guard (scripts/supabase-guard.sh).
A project ref is the 20-char id in the project's URL / Settings → General.
Refs are identifiers, not secrets — committing them is safe and is the point:
the guard compares the CLI's linked project against this file before every
db push / functions deploy, so a wrong `supabase link` fails closed.
NAMING HAZARD: the PRODUCTION project is named 'lend-staging' in the
Supabase dashboard; the STAGING project is 'lend-test'. Trust refs, not names.

production.project_name: lend-staging (despite the name, this is LIVE PRODUCTION)
